chunks: "You must engage in salat al-layl, for it is the sunnah of your Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and the practice of the righteous before you, and it drives away illness from your bodies."

key_terms.أَدَبُ: the way, discipline, and refined practice
key_terms.الصَّالِحِينَ: the righteous servants of Allah before this community
key_terms.سُنَّةُ: an established prophetic tradition and normative practice
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer; devotional worship performed during the night
key_terms.مَطْرَدَةُ: that which repels and drives away
key_terms.نَبِيِّكُمْ: your Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, whose practice is to be followed

ai.seo_question: What are the virtues and benefits of salat al-layl in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith urges believers to observe salat al-layl and presents it as an established sunnah of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the way of the righteous. It also highlights a worldly benefit of this worship, stating that it repels illness from the body.
